**Job Title: Embedded Software Engineer**
**Job Description**
 This onsite Embedded Software Engineer role in Loveland, CO focuses on designing and developing embedded firmware for next\-generation water quality instrumentation. You will work in a large, state\-of\-the\-art R\&D campus, collaborating closely with cross\-functional engineering teams to build new products and ground\-up architectures rather than sustaining legacy systems. The role combines embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare\-metal development with hands\-on hardware interaction, offering the opportunity to make a direct impact on global water quality while contributing to a growing, collaborative firmware team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and develop embedded firmware solutions for new and existing water quality instrumentation products.
* Develop and maintain embedded software using C\+\+ (and sometimes C) for microcontrollers and platforms including Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments.
* Modify and extend existing code bases to meet evolving product and system requirements.
* Analyze requirements, estimate development effort, and deliver reliable, impactful solutions on schedule.
* Collaborate in an Agile team environment, participating in daily scrums, weekly development discussions, and sprint activities.
* Work closely with hardware engineers, reading schematics and interacting directly with hardware to debug and optimize system performance.
* Troubleshoot and debug embedded systems using tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and digital multimeters.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD practices and unit testing to support robust, repeatable builds and high\-quality releases.
* Ensure code quality and reliability through rigorous debugging, testing, and adherence to best practices.
* Produce clear technical design documentation and contribute to system and industrial instrumentation architecture discussions.
* Develop and maintain device drivers and kernel\-level software, focusing on hardware interfaces and Linux internal behavior rather than only user\-space applications.
* Implement and support low\-level hardware interfaces and communication protocols including I2C, SPI, UART, MODBUS, USB, and Ethernet.
* Engage in hands\-on coding, building, deploying, and debugging activities throughout the development lifecycle.
* Participate in technical interviews and hands\-on exercises to assess, mentor, and support the growth of engineering talent.
* Collaborate with diverse, cross\-disciplinary teams in a highly integrated environment where design, R\&D, testing, and manufacturing are largely in\-house.
* Contribute to the growth and maturation of the firmware team, helping define and build new product architectures and development practices.
* Work on new product development initiatives, focusing on ground\-up architectures for embedded systems and instrumentation rather than primarily sustaining work.


**Essential Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related engineering field, or equivalent applicable experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in C\+\+ user\-space development and C (or embedded C) programming for embedded systems.
* 3\+ years of experience with 32\-bit microcontrollers and embedded platforms, including Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments.
* Strong understanding of computer architecture, memory technologies, and software build processes.
* Proficiency working in embedded Linux environments, with a focus on Linux internals, kernel device drivers, and hardware interaction rather than only application\-level development.
* Experience with device driver and kernel programming for embedded Linux platforms.
* Ability to read and interpret hardware schematics and work confidently with low\-level hardware interfaces.
* Ability to code low\-level hardware interfaces and interact directly with peripherals and sensors.
* Familiarity with industrial instrumentation architecture beyond general\-purpose computing or storage\-focused systems.
* Strong understanding and hands\-on experience with communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, MODBUS, USB, and Ethernet.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies and experience working in Agile software development teams.
* Strong debugging skills in both software and hardware environments, including use of oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and digital multimeters.
* Ability to produce technical design documentation and contribute to system\-level design discussions.
* Demonstrated ability to work comfortably with both hardware and software in a firmware/embedded software engineering capacity.
* Prior professional experience working with C\+\+ in embedded or systems\-level contexts.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative engineering team, taking ownership of tasks from concept through deployment.


**Additional Skills \& Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Embedded Systems Engineering or a closely related field.
* 5\+ years of professional embedded software experience is strongly preferred; candidates with a minimum of 2–3 years of strong, relevant experience and a demonstrated ability to learn quickly will be considered.
* Experience developing in a Linux desktop environment using both IDEs and command\-line tools.
* Experience with Embedded Linux build systems such as Yocto.
* Understanding of real\-time operating systems (RTOS) and bare\-metal development, including hardware interface design and implementation.
* Proficiency with scripting languages such as Shell or Bash, and familiarity with Python.
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP.
* Experience with Docker containers in a development or test environment.
* Exposure to user interface technologies such as React.js and Node.js is a plus.
* Experience in the water quality industry or with industrial instrumentation is a plus.
* Experience working in a diverse, inclusive, and highly collaborative engineering environment.
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts and trade\-offs to both hardware and software stakeholders.
* A proactive, “go\-getter” mindset with a strong appetite for learning new technologies and taking on challenging problems.
* Comfort working in an environment that emphasizes in\-house design, testing, and manufacturing capabilities.


**Work Environment**
 This role is based at a large, multi\-building campus in Loveland, CO, with a minimum expectation of four days per week onsite and Friday as a flexible day. The campus includes a state\-of\-the\-art building designed specifically for research and development, along with extensive in\-house capabilities such as a 10\-meter EMC chamber, HALT chamber, PCA/SMT line, injection molding, fabrication, and full production/manufacturing facilities. You will work in a collaborative environment that feels like an advanced, hands\-on engineering design lab, with close\-knit teams spanning nearly all engineering disciplines. The workday typically includes a daily scrum around 9 a.m., alignment on tasks and goals, and then focused time spent writing code, building and deploying firmware, troubleshooting and debugging hardware and software, and engaging in weekly development discussions to address system issues and interface requirements. The organization operates within a global network focused on water quality solutions, offering a culture that values innovation, collaboration, diversity, inclusion, and professional growth. The environment emphasizes direct access to hardware, lab equipment, and manufacturing resources, enabling rapid iteration and deep involvement in the full product lifecycle.

**Job Title: Software Engineer**
**Job Description**
 This role focuses on designing, developing, troubleshooting, and analyzing software programs for computer\-based systems within a complex defense environment. You will perform system modeling, simulation, and analysis while contributing to the design and development of compilers, assemblers, utility programs, and operating systems. You will also provide input for documentation of new and existing software, ensuring that systems meet rigorous technical and quality standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and develop software for computer\-based systems, including embedded and operating system\-level components.
* Apply object\-oriented design principles and design patterns to create modular, maintainable, and extensible software solutions.
* Perform system modeling, simulation, and analysis to validate software behavior and system performance.
* Design and implement software components, subsystems, and integrations in a Linux and UNIX\-based environment.
* Conduct software design implementation, subsystem integration, system integration, and comprehensive testing activities.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of documentation for new and existing software programs.
* Develop and maintain scripts for Solaris and other UNIX variants to support build, integration, and test activities.
* Use Integrated Development Environments (IDEs) such as Eclipse to write, debug, and maintain software code.
* Apply UML syntax to model software architecture, design, and behavior.
* Utilize xUnit frameworks, including JUnit and CppUnitLite, to develop and execute automated unit tests.
* Follow established CMMI Level 5 life cycle processes and procedures throughout the software development life cycle.


**Essential Skills**
* 2\-7 years of experience developing software in C\+\+ or Java in a Linux operating system environment.
* Hands\-on experience with software design, design implementation, subsystem integration, system integration, and testing.
* Experience participating in software requirements reviews, preliminary design reviews, critical design reviews, integration readiness reviews, and software acceptance reviews.
* Knowledge of Integrated Development Environments (IDEs) such as Eclipse or similar tools.
* Experience with embedded software development.
* Strong proficiency in object\-oriented programming and object\-oriented design.
* Familiarity with UML syntax and its use in modeling software systems.
* Experience with Windows, Solaris, and Linux operating environments.
* Experience developing scripts for Solaris and other UNIX variants.
* Experience with object\-oriented design and development, including the use of design patterns to enable software insulation techniques and plugin architectures.


**Additional Skills \& Qualifications**
* Experience with Python and Bash scripting.
* Proficiency with MS Office tools for documentation and communication.
* Experience working with integrated development environments such as Eclipse.
* Experience in embedded programming and software engineering for defense or mission\-critical systems.
* Experience working in UNIX\-based environments, including Linux and Solaris.
* Exposure to large, long\-lived defense programs and complex system\-of\-systems environments.
* Familiarity with the xUnit framework, especially JUnit and CppUnitLite.
* Experience working within CMMI Level 5 life cycle processes and procedures.


**Work Environment**
* You will work on a long\-term defense program supporting a highly stable and established missile defense system that has been in operation for over four decades and is used by multiple allied navies worldwide. The role operates within a structured, process\-driven environment that follows CMMI Level 5 life cycle standards, emphasizing quality, consistency, and rigorous review practices. You will primarily work with Linux, Solaris, and other UNIX variants, using technologies such as C\+\+, Java, embedded software tools, UML, xUnit frameworks, and IDEs like Eclipse. The schedule follows a 9/80 work pattern, providing every other Friday off and offering flexibility in paid time off. The facility environment supports complex software and systems engineering activities for government defense work, providing a stable and professional setting focused on long\-term program support.Support long\-term defense programs by delivering reliable, maintainable software that meets stringent performance and quality requirements.
